do_not_collapse: The same corporate-history page calls a 1978 Irie location its first directly managed Kurukuru Sushi shop; the market-history page calls the 1975 Kanazawa location Kurukuru Sushi 1st shop. Treat the two first-shop labels as different scopes until independently reconciled.

The market-history page lists sale of automatic sushi-forming machines in 1978; the corporate-history page lists Ishino's manufacture and sale in 1980. These may be different products or organizational scopes. Do not state they are one machine or that Genroku used either at Expo 1970.
